name: mirage
text: Thanks, that report helps. Two files on your tablet are big and get rewritten whole on every change: bets.json (9 MB) and oddspapi_free_cache.json (9 MB). On your 256 MB heap that causes the lag. I've fixed the second one in code: it now saves at most once a minute. It ships with the next release. The bets.json fix is next (LG1b). Separately, notifications are off for Vigilant on the tablet, so you get no alerts. Also, the Pinnodds live feed on the phone shows ON with real bets ON but not running, which I'll check as a possible cause of the crash when you start live. Two things in Android settings would help: Notifications on, and Battery set to Unrestricted.
